caption: The video depicts a clear glass tumbler heaped with a mound of white crushed ice, set on a dark glossy wet-looking surface with a faint haze drifting around the cup. In the upper-right corner a finger and a dark cylindrical nozzle are held near the ice. A thin stream descends from above onto the mound, at times faint and at times a narrow vertical line or short blurred column. This flow continues intermittently across the clip. The visible outline of the ice mound changes as the right-side peak lowers and a small distinct chunk protrudes from the top. The nozzle and finger gradually move out of the top-right of the frame while the framing drifts slightly, repositioning the cup. The stream is no longer visible in the later frames, leaving the ice mound and the vapor as the scene stands.
